In a survey of 80 males, 45 had played an organized sport growing up. Of the 70 females surveyed, 25 had played an organized sport growing up. We are interested in whether the proportion for males is higher than the proportion for females. The correct conclusion is that:
options: there is insufficient information to conclude that the proportion for males is the same as the proportion for females.
there is insufficient information to conclude that the proportion for males is not the same as the proportion for females.
there is sufficient evidence to conclude that the proportion for males is higher than the proportion for females.
not enough information to make a conclusion.
explanation: c. there is sufficient evidence to conclude that the proportion for males is higher than the proportion for females.
